title: approach-record/v1
description: targets/<id>/approaches/<timestamp>-<contributor>.yaml (D-14 mechanism 3): a strategy-level verdict for a route that never reached a formal statement. D-14 fixes the field list — schema, route, outcome (D-13's un-collapsible vocabulary), pinned_mathlib_sha, model_and_tooling, date — and this schema adds only target and contributor, which the file needs to locate and attribute itself once it is a file rather than a call argument. An informal proof of a specific node is not an approach record: it is an annex (D-31), which governs wherever both could apply. Earns nothing on submission by design (D-14); credit is retroactive and off this record.

contributor.description: The submitting identity's pseudonym; set by the service, never by the caller

route.description: Contributor free text, served as untrusted data (D-28); capped so it stays a verdict

outcome.description: D-13's vocabulary verbatim: what happened to the route, un-collapsible

blocked_on.description: The named library gap or prerequisite an outcome of blocked waits on (D-14)

pinned_mathlib_sha.description: What the verdict is relative to; a record predating a bump is stale, not wrong (D-14)

model_and_tooling.description: As declared by the operator (D-23); never verified
